companyFieldUpdates.name: Restaurant Technologies, Inc.
companyFieldUpdates.description: Restaurant Technologies, Inc. is a Mendota Heights, Minnesota-based route and installed-equipment infrastructure-services platform that provides closed-loop bulk cooking-oil delivery, storage, filtration, monitoring and used-oil collection, together with hood and flue services. It serves more than 45,000 U.S. customer locations through 41 depots and more than 1,200 employees. ECP completed its acquisition from Goldman Sachs Asset Management in April 2022; Continental Grain continued as an investor and Enlightened Hospitality Investments invested alongside ECP. Current company board materials retain representatives associated with all three investor groups. Exact ownership percentages, the ECP fund and acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed. GSAM's West Street Infrastructure Partners III had acquired the company in 2018 and exited in the 2022 transaction. Eagle Parent, Double Eagle Buyer, lenders, depots, routes and customer installations are financing entities or operating assets rather than separate owners or PortCos. No later company sale, ECP exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
